messages:
ashley_sales: Hey team — POC customer acct=acct_MN4P reports free credits went from 25k to ~200 overnight and they saw repeated 429s. They're asking for an explanation before the next demo. can we triage? :worried:
marcus_support: on it. can they paste a short client log window and confirm SDK version + if they use background workers?
ashley_sales: forwarded their snippet and they said SDK=python v1.3.8, using a Celery worker that retries failed tasks up to 4x. log:
```
2026-03-23T07:18:02Z INFO sending request tokens=1200 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-03-23T07:18:05Z ERROR http status=429
2026-03-23T07:18:06Z INFO retrying task
2026-03-23T07:18:08Z INFO sending request tokens=1200 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-03-23T07:18:09Z INFO success req_id=req_c101 tokens=1200
```
devin_eng: thanks. this pattern is classic: client retries after a 429/timeout and both attempts can be billed if the server accepted the first. pulling server-side logs for acct_MN4P for 07:00-07:30.
sophia_billing: metering summary: acct_MN4P consumed 24,800 units between 2026-03-23T06:50Z and 2026-03-23T07:25Z. free_credit was 25,000 at 06:50. metering_bot flagged rapid consecutive identical token counts.
metering_bot: anomaly detected: sequence of repeated token-sized requests (1200 tokens) count=20 within 07:15-07:20 window. possible duplicate-retries.
devin_eng: server logs show paired req_ids where first returned 202/accepted or 504/timeout and a later req_id returned 200. both recorded tokens. example snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T07:18:02Z] req=req_c0ff status=202 tokens=1200 route=/v1/chat/completions
[2026-03-23T07:18:05Z] req=req_c0ff status=504 tokens=1200
[2026-03-23T07:18:08Z] req=req_c101 status=200 tokens=1200
```
devin_eng: conclusion: duplicated consumption from worker retries. SDK v1.3.8 doesn't automatically send X-Idempotency-Key on retries. we should recommend upgrade to v1.4+ or set idempotency manually.
marcus_support: recommended immediate actions to customer: pause Celery retry for POC, upgrade SDK, add X-Idempotency-Key UUID per task. also suggest exponential backoff with jitter and check /v1/requests/{req_id} rather than blind resends.
ashley_sales: customer asked if we can credit them since POC is impacted and demo tomorrow.
sophia_billing: finance policy: we can offer one-time goodwill credits for clear duplicate consumption due to client-side retries. need eng confirmation of duplicated volume and ops to make a temporary concurrency bump to reduce 429s while they patch.
infra_bot: increased per-account concurrency for acct_MN4P from 5 -> 15 for 12h. ticket infra_inc_20260323_07.
devin_eng: estimated duplicate amount = ~24,000 units (roughly matching metering). propose credit 12,000 units after dedup check (split case: some requests legitimately retried). recommend presenting customer with full logs and proposed credit.
sophia_billing: queued credit request: acct=acct_MN4P amount=12000 reason="probable duplicate consumption due to client retries" status=pending finance_approval.
metering_bot: scheduled postmortem with metering and runtime teams on 2026-03-24 to discuss adding a short server-side dedup window for high-frequency identical requests without idempotency.
marcus_support: I'll draft a quick KB entry for POC onboarding: behavior of retries, idempotency header example, and how free credits are consumed. include sample curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFW" -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{...}'
```
ashley_sales: customer replied: "Pausing retries and upgrading SDK now. Appreciate quick help and the credit offer — will confirm after we rerun tests." :pray: closing unless finance needs more.
sophia_billing: will track approval and update thread when credit posts.
devin_eng: long-term RFC: consider accepting an idempotency-key or generating a server-side fingerprint and deduping identical payloads within 3s for POC tiers. putting on eng backlog.
ashley_sales: thanks team. marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
